messages:
sam_customer: Hey folks — noticed something odd: I made a few text-generation calls under my free trial but the credits balance didn't change. I can see token usage in the API response (tokens_used: 450) but dashboard still shows 1000 trial credits available :confused:

josh_support: Sorry about that, Sam. Can you paste the request id or timestamp for one of the calls? Also which account email/ID are you on?

sam_customer: Request id: req_2025-10-08_09:12:34, account: sam@example.com. Happened for 3 separate requests between 09:12 and 09:16. Using model: redwood/gpt-x-small, via REST.

josh_support: Thanks. Can you also paste the curl snippet you used (no API key) or the exact endpoint? quick check: was the Authorization header the trial key or a live key?

sam_customer: Used the trial key from the console (looks like TRIAL-xxxx). Example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer TRIAL-abc123' \\\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-x-small","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":150}'
```

josh_support: Got it. I'm pulling the usage logs now. Can you confirm whether you triggered any promo code earlier in the week? We had a small promo campaign that applied bonus credits to some trials and there was a bug where bonus credits were counted twice in the UI.

sam_customer: I applied promo code PROMO2025 on Oct 6. But the trial credit number looked right initially. The issue is that after several calls the counter hasn't gone down at all.

josh_support: Understood. I'm going to escalate to billing to check the backend token-accounter. @maria_billing can you look at account sam@example.com and verify whether token usage written to the billing ledger?

maria_billing: Looking now. I see the promo grant and a separate free_trial grant. There was a race bug in the grant-application job on Oct 6 that created duplicate grant rows for some accounts (grant_id: g-dup-783). For this account I see: free_trial: 1000, promo_bonus: 500, duplicate_promo: 500. The ledger then failed to decrement against the combined grant set due to a lookup mismatch (we were matching on grant_id, not on grant_type).

sam_customer: So requests are being consumed but not subtracted? Will I be charged?

maria_billing: No unexpected charges expected for trial accounts. We log usage but because of the duplicate grant row the UI read path shows remaining = sum(grants) but the decrementer tried to apply usage to the original grant_id which was empty. Effectively usage got recorded in usage table but remaining didn't reflect it.

josh_support: Action plan: 1) We'll remove the duplicate grant row and backfill remaining balance for you, 2) run a reconciliation for all accounts affected by g-dup-783, 3) fix the grant-application job to dedupe by (account_id, grant_type, created_at window).

maria_billing: I've queued a backfill for sam@example.com — adding a corrective debit of 450 tokens from the duplicate grant so remaining shows correctly. Also kicked off a batch reconcile for ~220 accounts flagged by the bug.

sam_customer: Thank you. Rough ETA? My app is live and I want to be sure usage continues to be counted correctly.

maria_billing: Backfill for your account should complete in ~15 minutes. Batch job for all affected accounts will run overnight; we'll post a report in the ticket. For immediate safety, I've applied a temporary UI-only flag that forces the dashboard to compute remaining from usage records instead of grants for your account. You should see numbers update now.

sam_customer: Dashboard updated — credits decreased. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

josh_support: Glad that fixed it. We'll follow up once the nightly reconciliation completes and when the bug fix is deployed to prod. I'm P1-ing the deploy.

billing-bot: [automated] Reconciliation job queued: job_id=rj_2025_1008_001, estimate 3h.

maria_billing: Notes: no billing exposure expected. For auditing I'll attach the reconcile diff to the support ticket.

sam_customer: Thanks everyone. If anything else needed from my side let me know.

josh_support: Closing loop once reconcile completes. If you see any further anomalies DM me. :eyes:
